items: NIGER STATE (PSI 9.3): Governor Bago Celebrates Groundbreaking of N1.8 Trillion Dualisation of 401km Federal Highway
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.1): Plateau Announces 6,000-Patient Free Outreach, Inspects 50% Complete Abattoir, Signs 2,000km Fibre Deal
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.0): Cross River Commences EV Training for 1,000 Youths, Signs 6,000-Job Fisheries Concession Deal
SOKOTO STATE (PSI 8.9): Sokoto Executive Council Approves N10.96bn for Arkilla Road Clusters, N7.84bn for Boreholes
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.9): Gombe Commissions 1MW Solar Mini-Grid in Talasse; Breaks Ground on 4MW Projects in Kaltungo and Kumo
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.9): Governor Sani Commences N2bn Compensation in Zaria, Flags Off 80km Road, Allocates Land in Jaji
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Abiodun Unveils Comprehensive Support Package for 10,000 Rice and Cassava Farmers
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.7): Zamfara Distributes Dangote IPO Shares to 36,176 Residents; Rolls Out Outbreak Emergency Response
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.7): Governor Otti Increases Scholarship Awards, Rewards Talent Winners, Urges Presco Investment at Ulonna
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.7): LSETF Partners Canva for 5,000 MSMEs; Lagos Issues Provisional Approval to 101 Private Schools
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.6): Adamawa Executive Council Approves Multi-Billion Contracts for Health, Education, and Airport Infrastructure
EDO STATE (PSI 8.5): Edo Power Ministry Targets December for 100MW Ologbo Plant; Launches OMO-SHINE Health App
KATSINA STATE (PSI 8.4): Governor Radda's Intervention Ends Health Workers' Seven-Day Warning Strike in Katsina
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.2): Governor Namadi Commissions N3.5 Billion ALREN Construction Plant Facilities in Dutse
ENUGU STATE (PSI 7.8): Governor Mbah Issues Executive Order Abolishing Tricycle Ticket Fees, Extends Operations to 10PM
KOGI STATE (PSI 7.6): Ododo Administration Completes New Administrative Building at Kogi State University, Kabba
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.5): Governor Fubara Rewards Real Madrid Academy Team with N50 Million Following UK Tour
KANO STATE (PSI 7.4): Kano State Government Commences General Renovation of Tudun Wada Zonal Hospital
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 6.8): Anambra House of Assembly Adopts MTEF Report for 2027-2029 Budget Framework
YOBE STATE (PSI 6.5): Yobe Government Approves Revised Monthly Salary Structure for Senior Civil Servants
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 5.4): Governor Eno Pays Condolence Visit to Family of Deceased Corps Member in Ukanafun
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 5.2): Governor Sule Receives Centre for Control of Small Arms Delegation at Government House
NIGER (PSI 9.3): Participated in the groundbreaking for the 401km Lambata-Bida-Mokwa-Kontagora highway dualisation valued at N1.8 trillion with Dangote Group.
PLATEAU (PSI 9.1): Announced free mega medical outreach for 6,000 residents, inspected 50% completed abattoir in Heipang, and signed 2,000km fibre optic deal.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.0): Flagged off EV maintenance training for 1,000 youths, signed 6,000-job Eburutu Fishing Terminal PPP concession, and ordered NYSC camp upgrades.
SOKOTO (PSI 8.9): Approved N10.96bn for Arkilla cluster roads, N8.54bn for airport dual carriageway, and N7.84bn for 200 solar-powered boreholes.
GOMBE (PSI 8.9): Commissioned 1MW solar mini-grid in Talasse, broke ground on 4MW solar projects in Kaltungo and Kumo, and targeted 62 additional communities.
KADUNA (PSI 8.9): Disbursed N2bn compensation to 865 Zaria households, flagged off 80km Zaria-Soba road, and allocated land to 712 Jaji families.
OGUN (PSI 8.8): Distributed 10 tractors, 1,200 Android phones with extension apps, and farm input packages to 10,000 cassava and rice farmers in Abeokuta.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.7): Approved Dangote IPO shares distribution to 36,176 indigenes across 14 LGAs and deployed emergency responses for diphtheria in Kaura Namoda.
ABIA (PSI 8.7): Raised annual scholarships to N350,000, presented talent hunt cash rewards, urged Presco Plc to invest in Ulonna, and built 1.85MWp solar grid.
LAGOS (PSI 8.7): Partnered with Canva to train 5,000 MSMEs in digital AI skills, issued QR approvals to 101 private schools, and graduated 1,800 LETI officers.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.6): Approved N1.63bn CT scan facility at Michika Hospital, N1.42bn Deputy Governor's office, and settled Song LGA herder market dispute.
EDO (PSI 8.5): Confirmed December 2026 commissioning target for 100MW Ologbo IPP and launched OMO-SHINE app linking TBAs for newborn immunisation.
KATSINA (PSI 8.4): Intervened directly to resolve seven-day health workers' warning strike, establishing a Technical Roundtable for CONHESS allowance implementation.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.2): Commissioned N3.5 billion ALREN asphalt and concrete production facilities in Dutse, employing 265 local indigenes.
ENUGU (PSI 7.8): Abolished ticket fees for tricycle operators across Enugu State and extended daily operating hours to 10:00 p.m. via Executive Order.
KOGI (PSI 7.6): Completed construction of the White House Administrative Building at Kogi State University, Kabba.
RIVERS (PSI 7.5): Granted N50 million reward to student-athletes and coaches of Real Madrid Football Academy Port Harcourt following successful UK tour.
KANO (PSI 7.4): Commenced general renovation works at Tudun Wada Zonal Hospital to upgrade infrastructure and patient healthcare delivery.
ANAMBRA (PSI 6.8): Adopted the Finance and Appropriation report regarding the 2027-2029 Medium-Term Expenditure Framework in the State Assembly.
YOBE (PSI 6.5): Approved new monthly salary structure providing N1.43m for Head of Service and N1.20m for Permanent Secretaries.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 5.4): Personally visited and commiserated with the family of late NYSC member Comrade Etimbuk Daniel in Ukanafun LGA.
NASARAWA (PSI 5.2): Hosted National Centre for the Control of Small Arms delegation to strengthen sensitization and state office allocation frameworks.
KEBBI (PSI 3.0): Routine administrative continuity maintained under normal civil service frameworks with no major executive policy intervention recorded.
